content: OpenRouter: Chat Completions is the stable compatibility path; Responses API is beta and stateless (function_call / function_call_output with call_id). Caching: automatic for most providers; Anthropic models need cache_control (top-level auto or up to 4 block breakpoints); usage reports prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and cache_discount; session_id for sticky routing. OpenAI automatic caching >=1024 tokens, 128-token increments, cached_tokens in usage.prompt_tokens_details, optional prompt_cache_key.
